name: Felmyst
shortDescription: Felmyst, represented in the Shattered Sun and Sunwell research story.
body: The fel dragon raised from Madrigosa's remains in the original raid account; the transformation is attributed to its secondary quest locator pending game review. Original image-generation art; not canonical game art or proof of exact appearance, costume, size or simultaneous presence. Compare it with the Burning Crusade patch-2.4 client/model before human review. See docs/research/shattered-sun-sunwell-visual-assets.json.
